mentions.name: Aged Care Mate
mentions.description: This platform helps families navigate and find home care providers in Australia, aiming to simplify the complex aged care system so people can stay in their own homes and make confident care decisions.
mentions.problem: Families struggle to navigate the complex Australian aged care system at an already stressful time in their lives.
mentions.audience: Australian families and their parents navigating home care decisions
mentions.source_excerpt:
